subject: textures DELTA5 READY: n2r graphics TLS + v9 oracle 12/12; wiring pending render/compute
body:
READY FOR REVIEW (n2r side only; no commit/phone/native/build). Changed owned files:
- gpu/metal/nord2_metal_render.h sha256 ef8c9b0ac9cf499782b060c40ca008667c22633967f89552ad4309a52e07dbec
- gpu/metal/nord2_metal_render.c sha256 15b4de156c5bdf1c06060b9c1592b7035a084f1e7d1635b56388fc6039e13bc1
- worker test test_n2r_v2.c + evidence-delta5.txt (not staged)

Implementation:
- n2r_draw_options.thread_storage_bytes = max(vs->tls,fs->tls), plus reserved; n2r_addresses.tls = resolved 4096-aligned base.
- One MALI_LOCAL_STORAGE at m+832 used by DRAW and both SHADER_ENVIRONMENT records: tls_size=pan_get_stack_shift(bytes), PACKED, base>>8, NO_WORKGROUP_MEM/WLS0. TLS0 is byte-identical; stale a.tls is ignored when bytes=0 so the LOAD preload can copy a.
- Public sizing helpers n2r_thread_storage_shift/total match Mesa pan_get_stack_shift/pan_get_total_stack_size; bridge can use total(bytes,2048,cores).
- Explicit refusal: bytes>32768, reserved!=0, missing/non-4096 base, base>>8>48 bits; output unchanged.

Tests (release + ASan/UBSan):
- n2r suite 12/12 PASS; TLS test covers 16/32/64/192/32768, v9 MALI_LOCAL_STORAGE_pack exact bytes, PACKED/base>>8, both stage pointers, TLS0 full-packet identity, invalid/refusal cases, total helper.
- tests/nord2_metal_render_test.c both PASS; texture helper 806/806 PASS.
- n2r host + ARM64 n2r compile PASS; bridge host compile with new header PASS.

Unresolved/cross-owner:
1. render: compositor_submit.inc:285 old four-field initializer needs two zero fields; full compute_frontend.m syntax currently stops there. Also Dispatch needs the selected max TLS bytes and v3 must be forced when TLS!=0.
2. compute: bridge draw_locked must allocate per=next_pow2(align16(bytes))*2048*cores, 4096-aligned, set a.tls, retain/release the BO, and fail BAD before build if unavailable.
3. No GPU/native/device proof; 2048/core is conservative and 32KiB/thread may exceed the 64MiB context budget (bridge must refuse).
No phone/adb/fastboot/USB/mount/publish/commit.
